51249823.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to His-tagged PPARalpha LBD (unknown origin) expressed in Escherichia coli Rosetta (DE3) at 25 degree C by isothermal titration calorimetry

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed on a MicroCal iTC200 instrument (Malvern Panalytical, Worcestershire, U.K.) at 25 °C. The His-tagged PPARα LBD (residues 1–260) was expressed in Escherichia coli Rosetta (DE3) and purified as described previously. The protein was dialyzed against 20 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, pH 7.4, and concentrated to 100 μM. The ligands were dissolved in DMSO and diluted in the same buffer to a final concentration of 100 μM. The protein was loaded into the sample cell (200 μL), and the ligand was loaded into the syringe (200 μL). The titration consisted of 20 injections of 2 μL each, with a 180 s interval between injections. The data were analyzed using Origin 7.0 software (MicroCal, Northampton, MA) with a one-site binding model. The binding affinity (Kd), enthalpy (ΔH), and stoichiometry (n) were determined from the binding isotherm. The heat of dilution was determined by titrating the ligand into buffer and subtracted from the raw data. The experiments were performed in triplicate, and the results are reported as the mean ± SEM.
